# Gradle Wrapper

`gradle-wrapper.jar` is the unmodified Gradle 8.9 wrapper launcher from:

https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/v8.9.0/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Copyright Gradle, Inc. and contributors. Licensed under Apache License 2.0;
the original license is included in `LICENSE`.

The downloaded Gradle 8.9 binary distribution is checked against its published
SHA-256 in `gradle-wrapper.properties`. Gradle distributions and dependency
caches are build tools and are not included in the Android application.
